rule.statement: A plaintiff with established paper title and a clear identification of the corpus can obtain a declaration of title and ejectment of a defendant who has admitted title and failed to show adverse possession.
rule.supporting_quote: Plaintiff has established paper title. Vide Loku Menike and another Vs. Gunasekera 1997 (2) SLR 281; Leisa and another V. Simon 2002 (1) SLR 148 at 151 – 153.
